items.title: Inspect eval/__main__.py for cleanup race condition
items.why_now: If cleanup runs before child processes terminate, temp files may be deleted prematurely or resources leaked. This affects reliability of the eval pipeline.

steps.do: Examine the main loop in eval/__main__.py after the call to harness.run_gate; check for wait, join, or synchronization before cleanup.
steps.verified_by: Observation of code order: if no wait before cleanup, race exists; if wait present, safe.

items.title: Compare ceiling.py and graph_delta.py for leaky layer detection
items.why_now: If ceiling.py excludes leaky movements while graph_delta includes them, mutations moving only leaky layers would be missed by ceiling's detection, causing false negatives.

steps.do: Inspect ceiling.py to see how it handles leaky layers (look for 'leaky' or 'detected_leaky').
steps.verified_by: Observation of code: if leaky layers are excluded from detection count, mismatch confirmed.

steps.do: Inspect graph_delta.py to see definition of 'detected_leaky' and whether it includes all layers.
steps.verified_by: Observation of code: if detected_leaky counts all layers including leaky, mismatch confirmed.

items.assumption: ceiling.py and graph_delta.py exist in the repository. Paths not given; may need to locate them.

items.title: Confirm reach.py safely ignores non-Python files
items.why_now: Shell scripts cause SyntaxError if ast.parse is called on them; if not caught, the scan crashes. Low severity because it's likely already handled, but verify to close the finding.

steps.do: Check reach.py's _scan function for try-except around ast.parse that catches SyntaxError.
steps.verified_by: Observation: if SyntaxError is caught and file skipped, safe; if not, bug.
